title: Cape Cod Curling Club
specs: Three sheets of ice with a fully equipped kitchen and well-stocked bar
Hosts multiple bonspiels including mixed, women's, men's, and wheelchair events
No special equipment needed; wear warm loose-fitting clothes and rubber soled shoes
Curling is open to nearly anyone regardless of age or ability; aids available for less mobile and wheelchair curling
includes: Instruction and all necessary equipment for curling
Curling games, meals and awards included in bonspiel entry fee
gap: Price for club rentals not stated
blurb: Guests play curling on three sheets of ice with all necessary equipment provided. The club offers rentals with instruction and social time, and hosts bonspiels including a wheelchair bonspiel. The club is volunteer-run and promotes curling education and community involvement.
extraNote: Rentals require minimum three weeks to set up · All beverages must be purchased from the bar; guests may bring food but must clean up · Bonspiel entries accepted through September 30, 2026 · Cape Cod Curling Club facility
